verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no self-serve audience export feature: nothing on exporting contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, or the suppression list in an open format such as CSV. What it does show are developer building blocks — the App API that can 'fetch data', a CLI returning structured JSON, MCP reads, and data-out integrations to other platforms — from which an export could be constructed, and these earn no credit under the partial-credit boundary.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
